criteria.requirement: Add optional parse kwargs max_depth/max_elements/max_text_chars (None or nonnegative nonboolean integer), validated before consuming input. Count depth including root=1, all element starts and cumulative decoded character-data lengths including whitespace (not attributes/comments). Raise XMLLimitError(ValueError) before constructing the offending element or appending excess text. Bound whole input even in item_depth streaming, namespace and chunked modes. Preserve unlimited defaults, entity blocking and callback stop semantics; do not claim rollback of callbacks emitted before a later limit failure.
